title: Senior Software Engineer, Wireless Radio / Firmware - 7+ yrs | BLR
teaser: We are recruiting a Senior Software Engineer to lead the development of radio firmware and driver components for wireless systems. You will design and optimise system-level features, collaborate with chipset vendors, and mentor engineers. Ideal candidates have significant experience in wireless or embedded software development and strong expertise in C/C++ and 802.11 protocols.
description:
Meet the Team 

The Cisco Wireless Feature & System Engineering team builds end-to-end wireless capabilities across access points, controllers, and cloud-managed platforms. We design features that span device software, control planes, and management systems to deliver seamless, secure, and high-performance enterprise Wi-Fi.

Your Impact 

As a Senior Wireless Radio Software Engineer, you will lead development of radio firmware and driver components, driving Wi-Fi feature enablement and system-level performance across platforms

Lead design and development of radio firmware and driver subsystems

Drive implementation of complex 802.11 features and optimizations

Debug and resolve challenging cross-layer issues (RF, firmware, driver, system)

Work directly with chipset vendors to influence and resolve firmware behavior

Optimize performance, scalability, and reliability of wireless systems

Mentor engineers and guide technical direction within your domain

Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve team efficiency and workflows

Minimum Qualifications -: 

BE/BTech with 7+ Years of experience or ME/MTech with 5+ Years of experience in wireless or embedded software development

Strong expertise in C/C++ and low-level systems programming

Deep understanding of 802.11 protocols, features, and system behavior

Experience with radio firmware, drivers, or data path development

Strong debugging skills across firmware and system layers

Experience collaborating with chipset vendors

Ability to lead subsystem design and execution

Preferred Qualifications : 

Experience with upstream driver development

Strong understanding of performance optimization and RF behavior

Experience in large-scale wireless systems
